references.text: Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, are also mentioned here as those who were to distribute the land to the children of Israel.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, along with the heads of the tribes, distributed the inheritance to the children of Israel in Canaan.
The heads of the Levitical families came to Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, and to the heads of the tribes.
Joshua, son of Nun, was appointed as Moses' successor before Eleazar the priest and the entire congregation.
Moses received command to give orders to Joshua and strengthen him, for he was to lead the people.
The heads of the tribes of Israel are mentioned here as leaders who were to assist Moses.
